echo_sets.name: Rite of Gilded Revelation
echo_sets.note: 2-pc: 10% Spectro DMG. 5-pc: stacks Spectro DMG from Basic Attacks, then grants 40% Basic Attack DMG when he casts Liberation. Main echo adds 12% Spectro DMG and 12% Basic Attack DMG; links with Twin Nova - Collapsar Blade.

echo_sets.name: Celestial Light
echo_sets.note: Temporary option giving ~40% Spectro DMG. Misses the Basic Attack scaling, so swap out once Rite of Gilded Revelation is ready.

build.fast_path: Run 5-pc Rite of Gilded Revelation on a 4-3-3-1-1 layout (Crit on 4-cost, Spectro DMG on 3-costs, ATK% on 1-costs), with Daybreaker's Spine as his signature or Pulsation Bracer as the best free alternative. Chase Crit stats first, keep around 120% Energy Regen, and stack Basic Attack DMG and Spectro DMG to fuel his aerial Ichor Flow loop.

ranked_weapons.name: Daybreaker's Spine
ranked_weapons.note: BiS. 588 ATK / 24.3% Crit Rate; +12% ATK, +20% Spectro DMG on Basic Attack hits, and Tune Strain - Shifting grants +20% Basic Attack DMG amp plus 10% DEF ignore.

ranked_weapons.name: Pulsation Bracer
ranked_weapons.note: Best free option (standard banner 5-star). +12% ATK and stacking Basic Attack DMG bonus against Tune Strain - Interfered enemies; roughly 87-95% of signature performance.

ranked_weapons.name: Blazing Justice
ranked_weapons.note: Solid stat stick with Crit DMG and DEF ignore on Basic-tagged hits; ~84-85% of signature damage.

ranked_weapons.name: Abyss Surges
ranked_weapons.note: ATK% and Energy Regen with Basic Attack / Resonance Skill cross-synergy; decent alternative but no Crit substat.

ranked_weapons.name: Aether Strike
ranked_weapons.note: Best budget 4-star (at R5 ~67-80% of signature). ATK + Liberation DMG buff window on ult; workable early but falls behind on base stats.

stat_priorities.note: Use whichever balances your Crit ratio toward ~70% Crit Rate / 240%+ Crit DMG.
Some builds run one Spectro DMG and one ATK% piece.

profile.role_note: On-field aerial hypercarry; almost all of his damage counts as Basic Attack DMG, built around Tune Strain / Tune Break mechanics

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Luuk Herssen's banner (3.1 Phase 2) and rerun (3.5) have both ended, so there is nothing to pull right now. If he reruns: pull only if you want a Spectro hypercarry and own his core enablers Lynae and Mornye, since he depends on them to reach his damage ceiling. Skip if you already have a strong main DPS or lack Tune Strain supports, as a unsupported Luuk underperforms.

members.name: Lynae
members.note: Tune Strain amplifier; grants up to +40 Tune Break Boost and team DMG buffs on Liberation and Outro.

members.name: Mornye
members.note: Healer/buffer; Syntony Field gives healing, interruption resistance and faster Off-Tune buildup; Outro gives 25% team DMG.

members.name: Luuk Herssen
members.note: On-field hypercarry; Golden Rule gives him +200 Ichor Flow and +12 Concerto when a teammate Outros into him (24s team cooldown).

teams.name: Premium: Lynae + Mornye + Luuk Herssen
teams.rotation: Open with Mornye's field and buffs, then quick-swap through Lynae to stack her team DMG buffs and Tune Break Boost. Outro Lynae into Luuk to trigger Golden Rule, then chain his mid-air Basic Attack strings to fill Ichor Flow and enter Aureate Judge. Cycle Aureole of Execution through its forms, detonate Ichor Deposit with a plunge, and finish with Liberation when all buffs are up.

members.name: Sanhua
members.note: Quick-swap sub-DPS; her Outro significantly buffs Basic Attack DMG with minimal field time.

members.name: Verina
members.note: Universal sustain; heals and grants teamwide ATK buffs in a few seconds of field time.

members.name: Luuk Herssen
members.note: Stays on-field longer between the low-field-time supports to run his aerial Basic Attack loop.

teams.name: Budget: Sanhua + Verina + Luuk Herssen
teams.rotation: Drop Verina's buffs, then rotate Sanhua through her quick Skill and Outro to hand Luuk the Basic Attack DMG buff. Swap into Luuk and run his full air-string rotation, spending Ichor Flow in Aureate Judge and closing with Liberation. Repeat with Verina's buffs refreshed each cycle.

tier_badge.label: Strong
tier_badge.note: Sustained aerial Tune Strain DPS with top-tier boss damage, but very dependent on Lynae and Mornye.

sequences.verdict: S0 is a complete kit. Aim S2 for the Liberation spike, stop at S3 for value, S6 only for whales.

pull_path.why: Complete kit — he plays the same from S0 to S6.
Liberation multiplier +60% with Tune Break Boost scaling roughly doubled.
Major damage jump on enhanced skills; the Tune Break rotation carry.
Big post-Tune-Break amp plus instant Interfered ramp.
